primary_use_cases: Memory toolkit for LangGraph agents; background memory distillation; pluggable storage
deployment_options: pip install langmem; runs with LangGraph deployments; LangSmith optional
integration_model: LangGraph storage layer + memory tools; active memory API; not universal interceptor
storage_backends: Pluggable — LangGraph store, vector DBs via LangChain integrations
memory_tiers: Short-term thread state + long-term store; background summarization/distillation
graph_model: Can combine with LangGraph graph workflows; not native temporal KG
multi_tenant_model: Thread ID, user ID in LangGraph configurable
extraction_approach: LLM-based memory formation utilities; automated background distillation jobs
update_operations: Update and delete memory entries via API; consolidation in background jobs
temporal_model: Thread timeline ordering; knowledge update via explicit memory edits
agent_fact_handling: Supports assistant and user turns in thread history
retrieval_signals: Vector search + metadata filters via LangChain retrievers
latency_profile: Depends on store; typical LangGraph overhead
token_efficiency: Retrieved memory slices vs full thread
procedural_memory: Tool memory patterns in LangGraph docs
benchmark_methodology: LangChain evals; compared in third-party blogs vs Zep/Mem0
stated_unsolved_problems: LangChain lock-in; not for non-LangGraph stacks without adapter work
public_roadmap: Tied to LangGraph memory store evolution
known_limitations: Requires LangGraph adoption; no OpenAI interceptor path
memorable_lacks: Working LangGraph store integration; background distillation jobs
memorable_should_port: Complete langchain.py callback; optional LangGraph store backend implementing same MemoryEngine protocol (C4)
